structured_output.summary:
I applied the q18 patch by hand on top of the q01, q02, q09 and q19 changes that were already in the tree. Nothing from q18 was present before, and its hunks went in without needing to be changed to fit the others:
- physical_hash_join.cpp: CastJoinFilterValueToStorage undoes the storage offset from integral compression. Join key sets up to 64x the dynamic OR-filter threshold are now pushed as a zonemap-only disjunction of ranges, split at the largest gaps between keys. The bloom filter is turned off when an offset is set.
- join_filter_pushdown.hpp: new storage_offset field and a new PushInFilter signature.
- join_filter_pushdown_optimizer.cpp: join filters can be pushed through __internal_compress_integral_* projections.
- cardinality_estimator.cpp: the SEMI join estimate now takes the size of its right-hand side into account.
- relation_manager.cpp: an extra selectivity factor for HAVING range predicates on aggregate results.

I added one guard of my own: the range splitting also skips HUGEINT storage, so subtracting adjacent keys can't overflow.

The tree builds (BUILD OK). Bench against the current best, all templates:

| Template | Best (ms) | Merged (ms) | Change |
|---|---|---|---|
| q01 | 334.0 | 282.8 | -15.3% |
| q02 | 78.4 | 42.1 | -46.3% |
| q09 | 920.8 | 501.6 | -45.5% |
| q18 | 599.1 | 561.4 | -6.3% |
| q19 | 309.0 | 149.4 | -51.6% |
| geomean | | | -35.4% |

A second q18-only run gave 618.9 → 523.2 ms (-15.5%), so its gain is real but noisy. Every template got faster, so nothing was guarded or dropped. The bench also checked results and they matched.
structured_output.generality:
This is the union of the five source changes, each still under its own general conditions.
- The q18 range-set filter only applies to equality hash joins on integer keys (not HUGEINT or UHUGEINT) whose hash table has more distinct keys than the IN-list threshold but at most 64 times as many. It is only used for zonemap pruning (OptionalFilter), so it can never change results.
- Pushdown through compressed-materialization projections only applies to integer types up to 64 bits.
- The two estimate changes only affect join ordering: SEMI joins whose right-hand side is smaller than the key domain, and aggregates filtered by a HAVING range predicate.
structured_output.notes: The q18 patch conflicted with the others only because nearby code in physical_hash_join.cpp had shifted, not because the logic overlapped. The bloom-filter condition there now has both an is_first_condition check (from the multi-key bloom filter change) and the new storage_offset check. q18's timing is noisy, between -6% and -15% across two runs.
